changelog: Fixed the CSM row covering Extensions and duplicating CloudStream's build stamp
Anchor the CSM row to the exact build-stamp text leaf and preserve the complete Extensions row
Match CloudStream's primary settings background without a tinted CSM band
Added CSM directly below Extensions and above CloudStream's build stamp using the native settings-row metrics
Removed the custom main-settings replacement and all floating fallback UI
Aligned CSM with the latest committed CloudStream 4.8 settings, player, result and plugin contracts
Preserved CloudStream's native Compose settings screen and fail closed on unknown host destinations
Updated episode, buffering, download, plugin, diagnostics and player targets with bounded current-first lookups
Aligned the build lane and Media3 API with CloudStream while producing a deterministic single-DEX plugin
Added safe previous-identity settings and installation migration without emitting legacy branding
Preserve queued generation-aware refreshes across Activity destruction and replay them on a valid replacement host
Stop the Audio Output receiver and polling loop when player injections are cleared, and use a monotonic clock for scheduler deduplication
Own pending settings layout listeners per Activity/root and remove them on success, root replacement, refresh-safe transitions, and Activity destruction
Send the verified HTTPS Discord attachment URL directly as outbound large_image, matching Discord's current Gateway Activity Asset Image contract
Added a selectable physical-device Artwork delivery test with Auto, Discord CDN, Discord Media CDN, mp:attachments and original provider URL methods
Added persistent credential-free artwork diagnostics containing the selected method and resolution stage
Direct/Custom Discord RPC and Kizzy/Broadcast RPC are mutually exclusive again to prevent competing presence writers
A configured Direct login owns presence updates; Kizzy is used only when Direct login is absent
Kizzy keeps its explicit package-targeted broadcast for modern Android compatibility
Fixed RPC artwork uploads being skipped unless a direct Discord account token was present; hardcoded webhook uploads now run for direct and broadcast/Kizzy RPC
Fixed asynchronous upload completion refreshing only direct-login RPC; all enabled watching-presence modes now receive the mapped attachment
Added PNG, JPEG, GIF and WebP signature detection for image CDNs that return generic content types
Hardcoded RPC webhook is now AES-256-GCM encrypted with fragmented key, nonce and ciphertext material inside the plugin
The plaintext webhook URL and webhook ID are absent from the shipped DEX; runtime decryption is integrity-authenticated
Discord RPC artwork now downloads and uploads directly through the intentionally hardcoded Discord webhook
RPC uses stable mp:attachments assets returned by Discord instead of provider image URLs
Direct webhook uploads enforce HTTPS sources, image MIME allowlisting and an 8 MiB limit
Dedicated activity-level Back callback now owns the CSM settings overlay lifecycle
Side panels fall back to CloudStream native controls when player data is unavailable
Failed reflected episode/source row actions now recover through native controls instead of closing silently
Fixed progress bar dropping below other controls during player hide animation
Fixed system Back and gesture navigation for the CSM settings overlay
CSM settings now block background touches and navigation
Fixed Episodes and Sources Side Panel buttons becoming unresponsive
Side panels preserve CloudStream native controls and fall back safely
Visible premium Contributors card for JinDevil with Discord API profile data, avatar and decoration
Fixed CSM installation URL and added builds-branch compatibility
Persistent CSM toggle state across settings reloads and fragment rebuilds
Legacy AndroidX/default preferences migrated into CSMSettings
Discord RPC and all modition switches now rehydrate from one store
Kool VOD now uses current www.kool.to mediahub POST contract (v16)
Kool Live TV now uses current catalog and dynamic HLS resolve contract (v12)
Silent injection by default
Progress overlay is opt-in
View inspector no longer installs a forced global input hook
message: Native CloudStream settings-row integration for CSM
